created_by_id.description: Filter to shared metrics created by these users. Accepts a single user ID, a comma-separated list, or a JSON-encoded array of user IDs.

event.description: Filter to shared metrics whose query references this event name — matched directly (an EventsNode) or via the step events of any action the metric references. For finding a reusable metric by what it measures; then confirm the match against each row's 'query'.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

metric_type.description: Filter to shared metrics of this type. 'funnel' also matches legacy funnel metrics, and 'trend' matches legacy trend metrics.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

tags.description: Filter to shared metrics carrying any of these tags. Accepts a JSON-encoded array of tag names. Distinct from 'search', which also matches name and description.
